ammonia.reason: Extensive amino acid deamination by Brevibacterium linens smear raises surface pH to 7.8 with free NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, phenol, indole and 3-methylbutanoic acid from Tyr/Trp/Leu catabolism by smear flora.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic rennet/plasmin peptides accumulated during 60d proteolysis, partly trimmed by smear peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and only trace heptan-2-one/nonane-2-one, no blue ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Free amino acids plus residual galactose drive Maillard plus carotenoid smear pigments on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by mesophilic lactococci, partially masked by smear sulfur.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very high 3-methylbutanoic 455-467 ppm plus butanoic 293-327 ppm from lipolysis and leucine catabolism.

creaminess.reason: 52% moisture plus rennet proteolysis and ~21% fat softens casein matrix to creamy paste.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet-coagulated, deacidified washed-rind paste deforms plastically rather than fracturing.

firmness.reason: Soft but sliceable washed-rind body with banded rind and DM ~48% from light pressing and brining.

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol rated ++++ and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine Ehrlich pathway by yeast/smear.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from ethanol plus free fatty acids esterification by Debaryomyces/Brevibacterium.

goaty.reason: Low hexanoic 14-103 ppm and absence of goat 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids in cow milk.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-methylbutanal/3-methylbutanal/isovaleric from Ile/Leu Strecker/transamination by B. linens.

melt.reason: Rennet gel demineralized then smear-deacidified flows readily on heating, not acid heat-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, present but lower than bloomy-rind cheeses.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from ~21% fat and lipolyzed protein network when melted.

smoky.reason: Only trace phenol from Tyr catabolism, no smoking step applied.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 267-743 ppm from lactate oxidation and heterofermentative metabolism by smear flora.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, casein network lacks aligned stretchable fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/dimethyl di-tri-sulfide and methional from methionine demethiolation by B. linens.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted during ripening, faint sweetness only from glycerol and amino acids.

umami.reason: High free glutamate from rennet/plasmin and smear proteolysis during prolonged washed-rind aging.
